units: <cite ref="Nedarim 7a:2">Ned. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>לנ׳ בעלמא</he> for general expense (not charity).

Tosef. B. Mets. IX, 13 (in a farming contract) ואנא בעמלי ובנַפְקוּת ידיי וכ׳ and I shall get one half for my labor and my outlay; B. Mets. 105ᵃ.—[In Talmud. comment. and casuists: נ׳ outcome, difference, v. נְפַק.]—Pl. (fr. נפקתא) נַפְקָתָא.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 31:1">Pesik. R. s. 31</cite>, v. <cite ref="M02142"><he>מְעַלָּתָא</he></cite>.
